correctness.rationale: The graph-theoretic degree-transmission identity and the exact attachment increments yield (4), and the path extremal bound makes its sign strict for every base tree with at least three vertices. The total-covariance recurrence and the Wiener mean give (7), whose harmonic closed solution is checked by exact substitution. A rational-arithmetic verifier enumerates all 5,913 recursive trees at sizes 2 through 8 and checks 24,271 exact assertions. Finite checks are supplementary; published variance asymptotics give the correlation limit.

value.rationale: Both indices are established natural summaries of tree structure and topological shape. The exact finite-size joint covariance exposes a negative dependence not determined by either marginal result, while the universal conditional one-step sign links this dependence to a concrete graph identity. The n² log n raw scale versus (log n)/sqrt(n) correlation quantifies nontrivial asymptotic separation; the result applies at every tree size rather than to an arbitrary parameter slice.
